chunks: And Saad ibn Abdullah al-Ash'ari narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fadhal, from Thalabah ibn Maimun, from Malik al-Juhani, from al-Asbagh ibn Nubatah, who said:

I came to the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) and found him thoughtful, drawing lines in the earth. I said: 'O Commander of the Faithful, why do I see you thoughtful, drawing lines in the earth? Is it out of desire for it?' He said: 'No, by Allah. I have never desired it, nor for the world for a day. But I was thinking about a son who will be born from my loins, the eleventh of my descendants, who is the Mahdi, who will fill it with equity and justice as it was filled with oppression and tyranny. There will be perplexity and occultation for him, in which some people will go astray and others will be guided.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali contemplate when drawing lines in the earth?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the theological significance of the Mahdi’s lineage, specifically identifying him as the son of the eleventh Imam, Hasan al--Askari. It underscores the dual nature of the occultation as a divine test where the faithful are distinguished from the straying, fulfilling the prophetic promise of global justice. The Imam’s detachment from worldly concerns emphasizes the eschatological weight of this future event.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 282 - Saad bin Abdullah Ashari has narrated from Muhammad bin Husain bin Abil Khattab from Hasan bin Ali bin from Thalaba bin Maimoon from Malik Jahni from Asbagh bin Nubatah that he said:

I came to Amirul Momineen Ali Ibn Abi Talib (a.s) and found him thoughtful. He was drawing lines on the ground. I said: “O Chief of believers, why do I see you thoughtful and making lines on the earth? Is it out of desire for the earth?” He said: “No, by Allah, I have never desired it, nor for what is in the world even for a day. I was thinking about the son, who will be born from my seed – my eleventh descendant. He is the Mahdi and he will fill the earth with equity as it will be full of oppression and injustice. There will be perplexity and occultation regarding him, in which communities will go astray and communities will be guided.”
